hooks.command: git pull --ff-only origin main 2>&1 || echo "[SessionStart] git pull FAILED — session continued anyway"

if git ls-files -z -co --exclude-standard '*.js' '*.mjs' | xargs -0 -r -n1 node --check; then git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -q -m "Auto-commit on session end: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')") && git push -q origin main || true; else echo "[SessionEnd] JS syntax check FAILED — SKIPPING auto-commit/push (fix the file(s) above, then commit manually)"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Syntax-checking JS, then auto-committing to GitHub...
